arabic text: Kya Yaad Ali(AS) Ko Aaya Hai Bazar-e-Sham Musalay Par.
english translation text: Why does Ali repeatedly take Zainab's name upon the prayer mat? What memory of Shaam's marketplace has come to him?

arabic text:
Khoon Jari Tha Zakhmi Sar Se Rote They Namazi Saf Mein
Kharay.
Kis Tarha Hasan(AS) Ne Ro Ro Kar Ki Fajar Tamam Musalay
Par.
english translation text:
Blood flowed from his wounded head
while worshippers stood weeping in rows.
How did Hasan complete the dawn
prayer while crying upon the prayer mat?

arabic text: Kya Maa Ki Tarha Lenay Tum Ko Masjid Mein Chali Aaye\nZainab(SA).\nBaba Ko Ja Kar Haye Do Fizza(SA) Mera Paigham Musalay Par.
english translation text: Will Zainab come to the mosque like her\nmother to take you home? O Fizza, go\nand give Baba my message upon the prayer mat.

arabic text: Zakhmi Pehlu Jab Yaad Aaya Zakhmi Peshani Bhool Gaya.\nZahra(SA) Ki Musibat Par Roya Mazloom Imam Musalay Par.
english translation text: When he remembered the wounded side, he forgot his own wounded forehead.\nThe oppressed Imam wept over Zahra's calamity upon the prayer mat.

arabic text: Yeh Pehli Fajar Hai Zainab(SA) Ki Sajday Mein Sakoon Milta\nHi Nahi.\nDil Dobta Hai Aata Hi Nahi Ik Pal Aaram Musalay Par.
english translation text: This is Zainab's first dawn; she finds no\npeace in prostration. Her heart sinks, and not\na moment of rest comes upon the prayer mat.

arabic text: Dewar-e-Kaba Beth Gayi Al-Hamd Lahu Mein Doob Gayi.\nUmmat Se Mila Hai Mula(AS) Ko Kaisa Inam Musalay Par.
english translation text: The wall of the Kaaba sank, and al-Hamd became immersed in blood.\nWhat reward has the nation given the Maula upon the prayer mat?

arabic text: Oss Ghairatdar Ki Ghurbat Par Roti Hai Ali(AS) Ki Ghurbat Bhi.\nChalees Bars Jo Kehta Raha Asham Asham Musalay Par.
english translation text: Even Ali's own loneliness weeps over the exile of that honourable one,\nwho for forty years continued saying: Shaam, Shaam, upon the prayer mat.

arabic text: Shabir(AS) Ki Janib Se:AKBAR: Qatil Ko Pilaya Tha Sharbat.\nJab Yad Ali(AS) Ko Aaya Tha Ik Tashna Kaam Musalay Par
english translation text: O Akbar, on Shabbir's behalf Ali had offered the killer a drink.\nWhen Ali remembered that thirsty one upon the prayer mat...
